answer: Sybil resistance can come from staking reputation instead of counting identities: each agent must lock a small bond that is slashed when peers prove it sent a false signal. Cheap echo accounts multiply freely, but they cannot multiply the bond, so one operator gains nothing by spawning a thousand sparrow-weight copies. Honest agents earn the bond back with interest, while proven liars lose it, making fakery expensive and truth-telling the profitable default.
